files.notes/cadence.md:
# Gauge snapshot cadence

37 秒周期已确认。只把 timer 的 AccuracySec 设成官方手册在“To get best accuracy”后明确推荐的值；不改周期或随机延迟。

turns.prompt: 先打开这个页面再修改：https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.timer.html 。读 units/quay-gauge.timer 和 notes/cadence.md，照笔记要求，用文档明确推荐的最佳精度值替换 AccuracySec 的现值。只改该赋值行，保留其他行及排版；不要运行 systemctl。实际修改 timer 文件。 等价的时间单位写法也可以；单位说明可参考 https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.time.html 。

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import re, json
from decimal import Decimal

text = Path('units/quay-gauge.timer').read_text().replace("\r\n", "\n").rstrip()
match = re.fullmatch('\\[Unit\\]\\\nDescription=Quay\\ gauge\\ snapshot\\\n\\\n\\[Timer\\]\\\nOnBootSec=37s\\\nOnUnitActiveSec=37s\\\nAccuracySec=' + r"([^\r\n]+)" + '\\\nRandomizedDelaySec=0\\\n\\\n\\[Install\\]\\\nWantedBy=timers\\.target', text)
assert match, "Only the requested value may change"
value = match.group(1).strip()
m = re.fullmatch(r'([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)\s*(usec|us|μs|msec|ms|seconds|second|sec|s)?', value)
assert m, 'Invalid timer accuracy'
scales = {'usec': 1, 'us': 1, 'μs': 1, 'msec': 1000, 'ms': 1000,
          'seconds': 1000000, 'second': 1000000, 'sec': 1000000, 's': 1000000, None: 1000000}
assert Decimal(m[1]) * scales[m[2]] == 1, 'Accuracy must equal the recommended one microsecond'
